title: iHeartMedia Reveals Celebrity Presenters and Attendees for the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*Tickets are available now via Ticketmaster.com*


*The 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina event will broadcast across iHeartRadio Latin stations nationwide*


*2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party returns to Miami Design District on October 15*


**WHAT:** On Saturday, October 17, iHeartMedia celebrates the **2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina** at Kaseya Center. The annual concert event will celebrate the power of Latin music with a star-studded slate of performances. Today, iHeartMedia reveals its list of presenters at the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina. To kickoff the weekend, iHeartMedia will also host the iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party. a free public event taking place at Miami Design District on Thursday, October 15 from 8:00-10:00 p.m.


**WHO:** Celebrity presenters and attendees for the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina include **Chikybombom, El Papi Will, Erick Brian, George Harris, Gustavo Trujillo, Howie D of the Backstreet Boys, Lele Pons, UFC Fighter and Miami-Dade Sheriff Deputy Luis “The Stache” Hernandez, Max Luiz and Miss Universe Cuba 2026 Mia Dio.**


Hosted by Enrique Santos, president of iHeartLatino and iHeartRadio personality, the event will feature performances by **Anuel AA, Myke Towers, Farruko, Manuel Turizo, Eladio Carrión, FloyyMenor, Greeicy, Alleh and Rey Tony Y Helabusador “Los Titi.”** This year’s event will also honor **Lin-Manuel Miranda** with the **2026 iHeartRadio Corazón Latino Award.**


Hosted by Enrique Santos, president of iHeartLatino and iHeartRadio personality, and Dayanara Torres, co-host of The Enrique Santos Morning Show, the **2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kickoff Party** features Tony Succar’s Unity: The Latin Tribute to Michael Jackson with special guest performances by Jean Rodriguez, Anthony Ramos, Howie D of the Backstreet Boys, COASTCITY and Leslie Grace.


**WHEN:** iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party: Thursday, October 15 at 8:00-10:00 p.m.


2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Main Stage Event: Saturday, October 17 at 8:00 p.m.


**WHERE:** iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party (Miami Design District, Jungle Plaza, 3801 NE 1st Avenue, Miami, FL 33137)


2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Main Stage Event (Kaseya Center,601 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132)


**MORE:** Guests can RSVP to the iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party[HERE](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2002636432479?aff=oddtdtcreator) .


Tickets for the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina event are available now at[TicketMaster.com](https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/0D0064C58CC07B23) .


iHeartMedia’s Spanish Contemporary Hits, Tropical, Regional Mexican, Tejano and Spanish Adult Hits radio stations will broadcast the event live in markets across the country and on the iHeartRadio app. Additionally, the iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina will broadcast across iHeartRadio digital stations including Beso, El Patron, Salsa Bembe, Rumba, Reggaeton Vieja Escuela, La Preciosa, Tejano Radio, La Mezcla Fuego con Dj Xtreme, Latino Top 20, Tropical Top 20 and Regional Mexican Top 20.


Proud partner of the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party is Major Food Group.


Proud partners of the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina main stage event include Audible, Boost Mobile, and Goya Foods with more to be announced.


For more information, visit[iHeartRadio.com/fiesta](https://www.iheart.com/fiesta-latina/) .


*Artists and/or event are subject to change or cancellation without notice.*
